name: On-the-one horn stabs
desc: James Brown horn-section chords in C dorian: a Cm9 hit ON THE ONE, tight F13 answers on syncopated 16ths, all fast-decay saw brass with shape bite. Answers thin out and thicken over an 8-bar mask cycle; peak doubles the hits an octave up.

code.full: stack(note("[c3,eb3,g3,bb3,d4]").struct("x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").attack(.008).decay(.32).sustain(.1).lpf(${bite}).shape(.35).gain(${gain}), note("[f3,a3,eb4,g4]").struct("<[~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~] [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ x ~]>").attack(.006).decay(.16).sustain(.04).lpf(${bite}*.9).shape(.3).gain(${gain}*.75).pan(.6)).add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").room(.25).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: stack(note("[c3,eb3,g3,bb3,d4]").struct("x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").attack(.006).decay(.28).sustain(.1).lpf(${bite}*1.2).shape(.4).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7, ${gain}).fast(4)).every(8, x=>x.add(note(12))), note("<[f3,a3,eb4,g4] [g3,bb3,f4,a4]>").struct("[~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ x x]").attack(.005).decay(.15).sustain(.04).lpf(${bite}).shape(.35).gain(${gain}*.8).pan(cosine.range(.4,.65).slow(4))).add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").room(.22).orbit(4).play()
